newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks mixed in London, exporters gain.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks mixed in London, exporters gain.

text.p: Japanese stocks were mixed in quiet London trading on Friday, with export stocks benefiting from weakness in the yen while banks were weighed down by unfounded rumours of another construction industry collapse, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 index of Japanese stocks trading in London was down just 0.16 points or 0.01 percent at 1,682.44.

Among exporters, Sony Corp was traded around 80 yen from its Tokyo close at some 10,880 yen, dealers said, while NTT firmed three yen to 1,153. Dollar/yen was steady above 116 yen, after reaching its highest levels in some nine weeks.
Among banks, Sumitomo Bank slipped to 1,880 yen while Industrial Bank of Japan edged lower to around 1,715 yen.
Elsewhere dealers said trading was quiet though yen weakness should continue to underpin the market.
"It has been a fairly typical Friday with not much going on," said one, "but the market should be pushing to the upside with the dollar at above 116 yen."
